description: Search for public Threads posts by keyword or topic tag via the /keyword_search endpoint. Results can be filtered by media type and author.

author_username.description: Filter results to an exact author username (no @)

q.description: Search keyword or topic tag to query

search_mode.description: Treat q as a keyword or a topic tag (default: KEYWORD)

search_type.description: Return most popular or most recent results (default: TOP)

name: threads_search_posts
